title: Beyond Deep Ensembles: A Large-Scale Evaluation of Bayesian Deep Learning under Distribution Shift

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy and calibration (e.g., signed expected calibration error) on toxic comment classification across different mentioned demographic identities, such as LGBTQ or Muslim groups, using the CivilComments-WILDS dataset.

Comparing the predictive accuracy (Pearson correlation coefficient) and calibration of asset wealth index estimations across underrepresented urban and rural subpopulations using satellite imagery in the PovertyMap-WILDS dataset.

Measuring worst-region image classification accuracy and calibration disparities on building and land use categorization across five different global geographical regions using the FMoW-WILDS dataset.
